name: eu-ai-governance
description: Source-grounded EU AI Act governance for European legal, compliance, privacy, security and AI governance teams: risk classification, DPIA and FRIA workflows, vendor and policy review, and evidence packs.

interface.shortDescription: EU AI Act classification, DPIA and FRIA workflows, vendor review and evidence packs, grounded in current law.
interface.longDescription: For in-house legal, compliance, privacy, security and AI governance teams in Europe. Classify an AI system under the EU AI Act as amended by the Digital Omnibus (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744), check the deadlines and obligations that apply, run DPIA and FRIA workflows, review AI vendors and policies, and assemble a traceable evidence pack. Every legal statement names its source and as-of date; the connected Lexbeam EU AI Act server answers deterministically from the enacted text. General guidance, not legal advice.
defaultPrompt: Classify our CV screening tool under the EU AI Act and list the obligations and deadlines that apply.
Which Article 50 transparency duties apply to our customer-support chatbot, and since when?
Assess ChatGPT Enterprise as an AI vendor for our HR team and draft the evidence pack.
